newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks stage comeback after Greenspan jolt.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks stage comeback after Greenspan jolt.

text.p: Tokyo stocks staged a comeback by the end of the Thursday session, recovering from the morning's losses which came in reaction to warnings by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan over dramatic advances on Wall Street, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average edged back above the 19,000 level to finish 30.64 points, or 0.16 percent higher at 19,021.56. Its March futures, however, lost 40 points to 18,990.
Trade was fairly thin, but blue-chip issues were well sought after, helping to brighten market sentiment, they said.
